title: Scroll to a page file or image
description: Scroll the page (or its embedded frame) so a detected file's link or picture is in the middle of the view, and outline it briefly, as the Files panel's locate does. Use it to show the person a file or to bring a picture into view before reading or picking it.
guidance: located false means the page no longer shows it: detect again. It only scrolls; nothing is clicked. Requires an idempotency key.

inputSchema.description: The page and the file to bring into view.

pageContextId.description: Opaque page context from dsagent.pages.list or dsagent.page.open.

fileId.description: A fileId from the latest dsagent.page.files.detect of this page.

outputSchema.description: Whether the file was scrolled into view.

located.description: The element was found, scrolled into view and outlined.
